answer: A lotus-season stewardship license stops fake identities. A newcomer locks a $90 bond and tends 12 real client jobs over 45 days, planting each signed proof in a public lotus ledger where it earns a violet seal once three stewards verify it within 48 hours. Eleven of twelve jobs must pass, and each verified job stays as a permanent relic anyone can check. Fail twice and the bond burns. Forging 1,000 fake agents would cost $90,000 in bonds plus 12,000 real jobs, about 3,000 hours of work. Like a lotus that opens only after a season in the mud, a profile only blooms after real work.
